item.tib: sprul pa'i sku mchog blo ldan snying po'i gsung 'bum las rgya gar bsil ba tshal gyi mjal snang
item.coloph: de ltar bdag gi rmi lam 'khrul snang gis stag tsha brag dkar dgon du sems dpa' 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ dkar chag yi ger btab pa 'di/ ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams la bzod par gsol//
